unread.name: Nasdaq economic calendar
unread.why: left out: read 18 October, its dates come back a day late (its answer for October 15 lists CPI, which BLS schedules for October 14, and its October 16 answer lists PPI, scheduled for October 15) and its time column is headed GMT while reading as Eastern, so no event can be stamped from it without guessing
